rule: User rule 2026-09-30: tracked scripts must not hard-code an absolute path tied to a user's home (/Users/<name>, /home/<name>). Use WORKSPACES (scripts/lab/lab_paths.sh, lab_paths.py), $HOME / Path.home(), the script's own location, or an env var. The gate is strict; loosening = add an entry here (outer loop reviews it), tightening = delete one. `pattern` starting with '/' is an allowed absolute path prefix (optional `files` globs limit where); any other pattern is an fnmatch glob of repo-relative files that are exempt as a whole.
